action.why: Diagnose whether the failed dependency installation can be recovered using writable storage, and inspect only the inherited chord grammar and helper functions needed to preserve OCR behavior. The parent’s null-only melody fallback and acceptance of zero parsed events explain why its local checks did not establish usable predictions.
